commonReference.documentTitle: Kushyameln Works AI推論モジュール 総合接続仕様書 Draft
commonReference.retrieval: Page body retrieved; not URL presence only
commonReference.relationship: Separate optional management descriptor; never sent as native protocolVersion

scale.alphaPresent: strength * alpha / rank; scalar zero and negative values are present values
scale.alphaAbsent: strength * 1 ONLY under this explicit pinned loader policy
scale.diffAndBias: strength * delta; no rank or alpha multiplier

loaderPolicy.rank: Positive safe integer from actual factor dimensions; down.rank must equal up.rank
unsupported: unknown tensor suffix anywhere, including excluded targets
general bias-learning scheme other than additive .diff_b
loaderPolicy.scopeNote: Subset of the fixed ComfyUI loader, not a claim to implement every variant supported by that loader. Names/shapes/hash do not certify training base compatibility.

registry.shape: Original full logical parameter shape, 1D/2D; no diagnostic shape substitution

kinds.initializer: Actual graph initializer or package initializer
kinds.hike-parameter: Actual Hike parameter, e.g. bias at declared operator position

registry.identityNote: Model/graph/registry/profile identity must be supplied by the consumer; examples use labelled fixture identities only.

full.mapping: Every original recognized patch must map with full shape; all unknowns reject
full.acceptance: Logical complete-adapter plan only; not full-model inference readiness

partial.columns: All columns; only contiguous output-row slices are supported
partial.globalValidation: All original patches are classified and structurally validated before selection; unknown tensors cannot be hidden in exclusions

selection.pairId: Opaque native selection identity; Bernini reference profile uses light/detail

sdk.source: size/read/hash with mandatory source identity for plan; File refs remain immutable caller-owned selections
sdk.revisions: SDK local revisions are never management revision or Diffusion transport inputRevision
sdk.preparation: Read immutable F32 full-base element offsets, calculate selected rows using actual Hike, emit owned binding-tagged Float32Array blocks
sdk.validation: v2 scope-bearing result must identify the prepared plan and coverage; boolean alone is rejected
sdk.receipt: Explicit STAGED or CONSUMER_APPLIED, with ownership evidence; neither means management snapshot published
sdk.stateNote: SOURCE_REGISTERED belongs to source host and SNAPSHOT_PUBLISHED to management. Native LoRA does not publish snapshots.

ownershipAlternatives.isValid: local callback, never cloned over port

ownership.base: Immutable, never patched in place; strength changes rebuild from base, never re-add to applied weights or subtract deltas
ownership.wasm: No pointers cross Memory owners; bounded Hike call completes before cooperative cancel checkpoint
ownership.sink: Must copy/persist block before writeBlock resolves; validate extent/duplicates/missing blocks and package/feed identity
ownership.prepared: Release forbidden during load/validation/commit and until consumer independent-copy or valid lease conditions are met
ownership.session: Consumer owns independent bytes or a valid lease for every future read; releasing prepared must not invalidate live session bytes
ownership.cleanup: Failed sink abort and release retain cleanup ownership for retry via recover()/dispose; new transactions blocked while sink-abort recovery remains
ownership.recovery: Rollback failure retains package as RECOVERY_REQUIRED; recover(prepared) retries rollback before release

v1Compatibility.legacyBehavior: Numeric apiVersion1 and boolean validate retained at existing entrypoint
v1Compatibility.registryAdapter: Explicit initializer-only conversion; runtime-input and hike-parameter cannot be disguised as graphInitializer
v1Compatibility.validationAdapter: Boolean true is not fabricated PARTIAL/FULL evidence; explicit scope assertion is required at version boundary
v1Compatibility.legacyPanel: v2 or staging-only connection must be rejected or explicitly adapted to state-aware UI, never labelled applied from preparation/staging
v1Compatibility.sinkAdapter: createV1SinkAdapter(sink,{registry:nativeV1Registry}) requires FULL/initializer, maps fullShape/local revisions and preserves native and connection identities separately
v1Compatibility.consumerAdapter: adaptV1Consumer(target,{side,executionProfileId,loaderPolicyId,validationScope:full-adapter,ownership}) keeps legacy-boolean evidence, opaque candidate lifetime, and original native rollback manifest

berniniReferenceProfile.instances: One SDK instance per side, coordinated by management snapshot
berniniReferenceProfile.composition: Not implemented; two pairs are selection/switch alternatives
managerResponsibilities: base state on detach with LoRA-only fields null
resource queue and child source-read ordering
berniniReferenceProfile.l2: Whole-target real consumer acceptance separately for light and detail after actual registry/provider/consumer exists

verificationScopes: Original full-file identity from retained inventory
deferredInputsFromDiffusion: Real graph binding registry with original full shapes and slice maps
Immutable owned F32 block provider and FP8 scale/decode profile
Sink package/feed schema and identity/hash rules
outOfScope: Actual real-base application before consumer receipt
handoffIdentity: Final complete commit and obtainable archive SHA-256 are recorded by the root in the handoff receipt; no circular self-digest is embedded here.

nativeMetadataHash.ordering: recursively sort object keys, retain array order; schema permits only JSON metadata
nativeMetadataHash.managementSnapshotHash: separate owner/contract, not implemented or certified by this scheme
